The search retrieved **748 records** at the 2014-08-09 Entrez-date cutoff. The [audit](</C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-a01e5029fcbb87a3/ours-codex-noseed-20260928T210934Z/work/audit.md>) contains the line-by-line query with counts.

Five studies screened into the development set were retrieved: **5/5 (100% relative development recall)**. This is not independent validation or absolute sensitivity. A 30-record sample of records excluded by the neonatal block contained no eligible study; that block reduced the measured count by 91%.

The closing internal critic accepted residual uncertainty because category probes became stale after qPCR terms were added and their redraw budget was exhausted. The reference-standard eligibility definition also remains underspecified, and should be clarified in the review protocol. The [narrative](</C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-a01e5029fcbb87a3/ours-codex-noseed-20260928T210934Z/work/narrative.md>) records these assumptions and risks.
